non_residential_details.development_type: Change of Use with Extension(s) over 999sqm

description: Change of Use from offices to 69 bedroom hotel with ancillary meeting rooms, caf?, and lounge.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To protect the visual amenities of the area
Condition : 4 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 8am to 8pm.Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.

Condition : 5 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing No. Z227-06 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, and in the interests of road safety.

Condition : 7 - Details of disabled access to the premises and details of disabled toilet facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the occupation of the approved use.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with approved details.

Reason:  To ensure that satisfactory access for people with disabilities is provided.

Condition : 8 - Details of any fume extraction equipment, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant, which may be required for the caf? ancillary to the hotel shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with approved details.Reason:  In order that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied as to the arrangements for preventing loss of amenity to neighbouring premises due to fumes and smells.

Condition : 9 - The caf? use shall be ancillary to the main hotel use and shall be confined to sales to customers residing at the hotel.

Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of the adjoining residential properties.

Condition : 10 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed change of use to a hotel would be acceptable in this location, would retain an employment use on the site and would contribute to the vitality of the Town Centre.  The proposal complies with adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), EN.1.1 (Location of New Employment Uses), E.5.1 (visitor Accommodation), E.5.1 (visitor Accommodation), E.5.2 (conference and Exhibition Facilities), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
